2.3.25 Report.BottomMargin
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.BottomMargin element specifies the width of the bottom margin of a Report. The
Report.BottomMargin element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "0in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.BottomMargin element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.BottomMargin element.
 <xsd:element name="BottomMargin" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
